# Segnals MCP Server
> Manage algorithmic trading bots, strategies, and portfolio via AI agents.

## Install

The server is not published to npm. There are two ways to run it, both with `SEGNALS_API_KEY` set in the environment:

- Docker image on GHCR: `docker run --rm -i -e SEGNALS_API_KEY ghcr.io/eidostein/segnals-mcp:latest`
- Build from source: `git clone https://github.com/eidostein/segnals-mcp.git && cd segnals-mcp && npm ci && npm run build`, then `node dist/index.js`
